resolutions.researcher_notes: Status=construction reconfirmed by 3 independent, live, verified sources, all specifically about the Structure E / Structures A&E development (not the sibling P6708 NC 41-Mellitah Gas Pipeline, which is a distinct line out of the same NC-41/Contract Area D concession -- checked route/segment descriptions in each source to keep them separated). (1) offshore-technology.com project page: describes the Structure E gas export pipeline design and states first gas/onstream 'expected...in 2026' -- i.e. not yet operating. (2) attaqa.net (Al-Taqa, Arabic energy trade outlet, 2025-08-11): reports Mellitah Oil & Gas (NOC/Eni JV) signing an $8bn EPC-related contract package (with Hill International as project management consultant) with commercial startup still targeted for 2026 ('بدء التشغيل التجاري المتوقع في عام 2026'), confirming the project is still being built, not operating. (3) petrogaslibya.com 2026 outlook piece: still describes Structures A&E as scheduled to start production in 2026, i.e. under construction. No source found reporting FID reversal, cancellation, or an early/actual startup. The sheet's prior current_ref combo (mellitahog.ly/.../02.pdf + offshore-technology.com?cf-view) both actually resolve live once the tracking query string/redirect wrapper is stripped -- the mellitahog.ly PDF (see Length/Diameter units) is a real 2021 Mellitah Oil & Gas prequalification tender document, but it's a project-scope document from a pre-construction planning stage, not a current-status source, so I did not reuse it here; the more recent independent sources above are better evidence for current Status.

Automated screen reports this URL as 'value not found' -- that is a false negative: the check reads the raw HTTP body, which for a PDF is a compressed binary stream, not searchable text. Downloaded the PDF and ran pdftotext manually: it IS live (HTTP 200, 6-page PDF) and is Mellitah Oil & Gas B.V.'s own Feb-2021 EPCIC prequalification tender ('A&E STRUCTURES, MELLITAH COMPLEX EXPANSION & CO2 MANAGEMENT INTEGRATED DEVELOPMENT PROJECT'). It explicitly and separately describes the Structure A route (18in/43km to Sabratha Platform -- a different segment, not this one) and the Structure E route: 'A new gas sealine (32" to be verified during FEED) 130 km long [deliver] E Structure production to Mellitah' -- 130 km matches the sheet's recorded LengthKnown exactly. IMPORTANT CAVEAT (per brief): this is the pre-FEED design estimate. The project's later, post-FID (2023) public description at offshore-technology.com instead states a shorter, revised design -- 'A 30km-long and 36in-diameter gas pipeline will deliver production from Structure E to an existing 36in gas export pipeline from the Sabratha Platform to the Mellitah Complex' -- i.e., after FEED, Structure E ties into the EXISTING Sabratha-Mellitah trunk rather than running a new 130km line all the way to Mellitah as originally scoped. So the sheet's 130km value is real and sourced (matches this primary document exactly) but reflects an earlier design phase; the apparently 'final'/most-recent figure per offshore-technology.com is 30km. Only ONE source gives 130km specifically for the Structure E sealine (a similar, earlier 2018 mellitahog.ly scope-of-work doc gives the same ~130km distance but a 30in diameter -- same operator, not independent, so not counted as a second source). Flagging this design-stage discrepancy for the data team; staged as medium/single-source rather than fabricating a second independent confirmation of 130km specifically.

Same source and same caveat as the Length unit above (see that entry for full detail on the manual PDF verification). The same sentence in Mellitah Oil & Gas's Feb-2021 EPCIC prequalification tender gives diameter explicitly: 'A new gas sealine (32" to be verified during FEED) 130 km long [deliver] E Structure production to Mellitah' -- 32in matches the sheet's recorded Diameter exactly, with the document's own caveat that this figure was still 'to be verified during FEED' at the time. Per the brief's caution: the project's later, post-FID (2023) design at offshore-technology.com instead specifies 36in for the Structure E export tie-in ('A 30km-long and 36in-diameter gas pipeline will deliver production from Structure E to an existing 36in gas export pipeline from the Sabratha Platform to the Mellitah Complex'), and a related condensate line is separately given as 14in (2021 doc) vs 10in (2023 source) -- consistent evidence the design was revised between the 2021 pre-FEED tender and the 2023 post-FID public description. Only one source (the 2021 tender) supports 32in specifically; no second independent source found giving 32in (the 2018 scope doc gives 30in instead, and is not independent of the 2021 doc -- same operator). Staged as medium/single-source; flagging the 32in-vs-36in discrepancy for the data team rather than silently reconciling it.

Two independent sources confirm StartCountryOrArea=Libya and EndPrefecture/District=Mellitah / EndCountryOrArea=Libya. (1) offshore-technology.com (GlobalData trade press): the Structure E gas export pipeline 'will deliver production from Structure E to an existing...gas export pipeline from the Sabratha Platform to the Mellitah Complex,' with the Mellitah Complex located '22km away from Zwara City near Tripoli' -- all in Libya. (2) mellitahog.ly's own Feb-2021 EPCIC tender document (verified manually via pdftotext -- see Length/Diameter units): 'E-Structure is located...in the central-eastern part of the Area D (ex NC41 area), about 130 Km far from the Libyan coast' with the new gas sealine explicitly routed to 'deliver E Structure production to Mellitah.' Both sources are specifically about the Structure E line (not the sibling P6708 NC 41-Mellitah Gas Pipeline). The Start side is an offshore field/platform (no onshore administrative location), consistent with the sheet leaving StartLocation/StartPrefecture/StartState-Province blank; EndPrefecture/District='Mellitah' is directly corroborated by both sources.
